# R5.15b — Planned-population consumer adapter (leg b of the `4d13371f` SPLIT — seq 184a)

**Summary.** Wires the hh-analysis consumer to the R5.15 population
contract: `hharness_analysis::population::planned_population(view,
runs, tasks, metric_ref, pins)` adapts `ExperimentView`
plans/attempts/`launch_binding` × `EvalRun` outcome/success/
`disposition:"pending"` into the contract records and calls
`hharness_eval::population::assemble` **unchanged** — no second
population predicate. Ticket
`docs/tickets/184a_R5.15b__population-adapter.md` (seq 184a);
split-review record
`docs/build/planning/2026-11-02_R5.15b-split-review.md`. The adapter
was written pre-split (checkpoint `e6b256f9`) and moved out of leg (a)
by the corrected seam; this leg recovers it **verbatim** — the landed
eval contract diffed byte-identical to the checkpoint's, so no
adjustment was needed.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-analysis/src/population.rs` (new, 146 lines — verbatim
  `e6b256f9`) — `planned_population`: each `PlanState` → one
  `PlannedSlot`; bound subjects = `attempts` ∪ `launch_binding` deduped
  by run id (the attempt record wins — it carries the settled
  outcome/veto axes); `success` resolves the named metric on the bound
  `EvalRun` (`bool`/`decimal`/`verdict-N`; lattice `P`/`I`/`n/a` or
  absent stays `None` — unknown never coerced); `availability` reads
  the admitted disposition — `pending` → `Pending` (R5.14b's
  consumer contract, consumed unchanged), `oracle_failure` →
  `Unavailable`, resolved outcome → `Resolved`, else `NotRun`; `seq`
  reads the declared pin (`0` = unresolved). `assemble` does all
  contract validation — the adapter only maps (X7).
- `crates/hh-analysis/src/error.rs` (+10) — `AnalysisError::Population(
  PopulationError)` variant + `Display` + `From` — the same refusal
  vocabulary, never a second rule.
- `crates/hh-analysis/src/lib.rs` (+1) — `pub mod population`.
- `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_15.rs` (new, 3 checks) — the two
  recovered checks verbatim plus one additive Phase-4 gap-closure
  check for AC-1's launch-binding dedup clause (the recovered battery
  left that path test-dead).
- Zero new event classes, zero dependencies (`hharness-eval` already
  an hh-analysis dep), no schema/wire change; records-in mapping only.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1 (positive D/E) — MET:** real `ExperimentView` + `EvalRun`
  inputs reconcile into the same contract unchanged —
  `adapter_reconciles_planned_slots_first_subjects_and_attempts`
  (oracle-failed first subject + completed admissible retry →
  `member=r-retry`, `recovered`, `n_attempts=2`; unbound plan keeps its
  planned/not-run row; raw `(s,f,u)=(1,1,1)`; ordering preserved by the
  contract) and `adapter_launch_binding_dedups_attempt_and_binds_
  launch_only_subject` (attempt-vs-launch-binding dedup →
  `n_attempts=1`; a launch-only binding still binds a `NotRun`
  subject).
- **AC-2 (negative D/E) — MET:**
  `adapter_pending_disposition_is_unresolved_not_full` — pending
  `EvalRun.disposition` → `u=1` + `pending_slots=[p1]` +
  `complete=false` (R5.14b composition unchanged); typed refusals
  propagate as `AnalysisError::Population` (`From<PopulationError>`);
  no divergent population predicate (single `assemble` call).
- **AC-3 (ownership/evidence E) — MET (scoped-slice stamps only):**
  REQ-D-001/002/003/104 + REQ-A-004/102 recorded
  contributing/scoped-slice at the consumer layer; **no REQ discharged
  by either leg** — contract legs stamped seq 184; R/P legs remain
  owed to R5.49 (D-*) and R5.43 (A-*).
- **AC-4 (scoped verification E/D) — MET:** fails-without compile-red
  at base `45532e7e` (`E0432 unresolved import
  hharness_analysis::population`, scratch worktree);
  `cargo fmt --all --check` clean; `cargo test -p hharness-analysis`
  72 tests / 0 failures incl. `tests/r5_15.rs` 3/3; commands and
  counts in `runs/R5.15b.md`; scratch stores only.
- **AC-5 (universal gate D/E) — MET:** guard PASS `DISPATCH — R5.15b`
  pre+post; REQ ids stamped here; DF-R5.1-1 carried (no deferrals
  opened/closed); pure composition — no new owned decisions → no ADR;
  run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree.
